# Rights and access

The repository MIT license applies to curator-written code, documentation and derived data covered by that license. See LICENSE.txt. Source-provided titles, short labels, URLs, metadata and attribution are preserved for provenance; their inclusion does not transfer ownership of the sources.

No license is granted here for third-party audio, video, transcripts, captions, books, artwork or full publisher-written messages. Those materials are excluded from this public metadata bundle. Full media/text is retained in a private research archive pending documented, source-specific redistribution rights. Fields such as source_license=not_established_for_redistribution describe this unresolved source-content state; they do not license the source.

A source being publicly accessible, downloadable, mirrored, or linked from YouTube does not create a redistribution license. Publisher-page audio/text cooccurrence does not establish audiovisual equivalence or word alignment. Requests for correction, source removal or permission evidence should identify the source_id, edition_id and source URL through the repository issue tracker.

Repository: https://github.com/occult-kranti/channels-ET
